preconditions.description: The input string s must be non-empty and have a length of at most 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string s must be one of 'A', 'B', 'C', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: any('A' in petals and 'B' in petals and 'C' in petals for petals in possible_petals(s))
postconditions.description: There must exist at least one cell that contains all three colours ('A', 'B', and 'C') after some flowers shed their petals.
